live_count_registry_row.count_reason: The paper reports on 10 original SPS-spectrum patients referred for consideration of auto-HSCT between 2015 and 2019. Detailed clinical and demographic data are provided for all 10 patients, including those who did not undergo transplantation. Four of these patients received auto-HSCT, but all 10 are original SPS-spectrum cases described in the cohort.

live_source_registry_row.categorisation_reason: This is an observational group study describing the UK experience with auto-HSCT in refractory SPS. The paper provides both group-level and individual-level data for 10 original SPS-spectrum patients, including detailed case summaries and a table with per-patient data. It is not a review, case report, or interventional trial.
